findings.evidence: The scalar proofs use only `degree_diagCoset_const` (line 145), `natDiagGL_const_comm` (line 127), `natDiagGL_mul` (line 122) and `transposeAntiInvolution_onHeckeCoset_eq_self` (line 205); `exists_mul_congMod_of_coprime` is first used at line 315, in the coprime section.
findings.fix: Split the scalar section into `TauCeti/NumberTheory/HeckeRing/GLn/ScalarMul.lean` importing only `GLn/Degree`, `GLn/TransposeAntiInvolution` and (privately) `Multiplicity/Support`; let `CoprimeMul.lean` import it if it needs anything.
findings.issue: `section Scalar` (lines 57-210: `diagElem_const_mul`, `diagElem_mul_const` and their helpers) has no dependency on coprimality or the CRT splitting, yet lives in a file whose whole point is the coprime rule and which `public import`s `SpecialLinearGroup/CongruenceSplit`. Anyone wanting `T(c,…,c)·T(b) = T(cb)` drags in the transvection/CRT development.

findings.evidence: Grep for `natDiagGL_const_coe` across `TauCeti/` returns only its definition at CoprimeMul.lean:60. `exists_rep_diagCoset_eq_mul_natDiagGL_mul` proves itself from `diagCoset_toSet` (DiagonalCosets.lean:182), `HeckeCoset.rep_mem` (HeckeRing/Basic.lean:92) and `mem_doubleCoset`, all available in `DiagonalCosets.lean`.
findings.fix: Move the three to `DiagonalCosets.lean` — the first two beside `natDiagGL_const_comm` (line 131), the rep decomposition beside `diagCoset_toSet` (line 182) — or drop `natDiagGL_const_coe` if it has no consumer.
findings.issue: `natDiagGL_const_coe` (60), `natDiagGL_const_conj_eq` (66) and `exists_rep_diagCoset_eq_mul_natDiagGL_mul` (80) are plain `natDiagGL`/`diagCoset` API with no Hecke-multiplication content; they belong in `GLn/DiagonalCosets.lean`, the file this PR already moved `natDiagGL_const_comm` into. `natDiagGL_const_coe` is used nowhere in the repository.

findings.evidence: Degree.lean:54-59 proves `natDiagGL n (fun _ ↦ c) ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (SLnZ n)` from `natDiagGL_const_comm` and closes with `Subgroup.conjAct_pointwise_smul_eq_self` — the exact content of CoprimeMul.lean:72-77. Grep for `conjAct_rep_diagCoset_const_smul_eq` returns only its definition at line 93.
findings.fix: Move both to `GLn/Degree.lean` next to `degree_diagCoset_const` and use `conjAct_natDiagGL_const_smul_eq` in that proof instead of the inline `hnorm`, or delete them if nothing consumes them.
findings.issue: `conjAct_natDiagGL_const_smul_eq` (72) and `conjAct_rep_diagCoset_const_smul_eq` (93) restate downstream the centrality/normalizer fact that `degree_diagCoset_const` re-derives inline, and neither is used by any result in this PR or the repo (the second is used nowhere; the first only feeds the second).

findings.evidence: `linear_combination` appears only at CongruenceSplit.lean:59 (proof body). The sibling `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/SpecialLinearGroup/Basic.lean:11` imports the same module non-publicly, which is the repo-wide convention for tactic imports.
findings.issue: `public import Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination` exports a tactic-only module into this file's public interface; the tactic is used solely inside the proof of the private `transvection_CRT`.

summary: The scalar row of the multiplication table (Shimura 3.17) is placed in CoprimeMul.lean behind the CRT/transvection import it does not use, and several natDiagGL/diagCoset lemmas belong in the earlier DiagonalCosets.lean or Degree.lean — two of them are used nowhere at all. A tactic-only import is made public against the repo convention.
